description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Module' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting' namespace. The class provides methods for managing modules, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving module data from the database.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A model class for handling CRUD operations related to modules in the admin setting context within OpenCart.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Inserts a new module record into the database with the provided code and data, returning the new module's ID.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates an existing module's details in the database identified by module_id, with new data.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module from the database by its ID.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Removes all modules from the database that match the specified code, also deleting associated layout modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the settings for a specific module by its ID, decoded from JSON.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns all modules ordered by their code.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Fetches all modules that have the specified code.
